item.title: Philnikos Ersmachides ~155 took the staff in the Boule for the Argyreoi: "Hear me! Remembe
item.description: Philnikos Ersmachides ~155 took the staff in the Boule for the Argyreoi: "Hear me! Remember the stone in Field of Ares. I say: let the temples get their tithe. As the old poet says, the half is more than the whole." The assembly roared like the long waves of the Icarian sea.
